mapper.insert: insert into safety.safety_car_rule_white (car_no, emp_no, remark, create_time, update_time, status) values (#{carNo}, #{empNo}, #{remark}, now(), now(), 0)

insert into safety.safety_car_rule_white (car_no, emp_no, remark, create_time, update_time, status) values
(#{item.carNo}, #{item.empNo}, #{item.remark}, now(), now(), 0)
mapper.update: update safety.safety_car_rule_white set status = 1 where id = #{id}

update.foreach: update safety_car_rule_white set car_no = #{item.carNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remark = #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = now() where emp_no = #{item.empNo}

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.car_no, t.emp_no, e.emp_name, e.org_name dept, t.remark FROM safety.safety_car_rule_white t left join safety.safety_employee_message e on e.emp_no = t.emp_no where t.status = 0
and t.car_no like concat('%',#{param.carNo},'%')
and t.emp_no like concat('%',#{param.empNo},'%')
and e.emp_name like concat('%',#{param.empName},'%')
and e.org_name like concat('%',#{param.dept},'%')
order by t.create_time desc limit #{start}, #{size}

select count(1) from safety.safety_car_rule_white t left join safety.safety_employee_message e on e.emp_no = t.emp_no where t.status = 0
and t.car_no like concat('%',#{carNo},'%')
and t.emp_no like concat('%',#{empNo},'%')
and e.emp_name like concat('%',#{empName},'%')
and e.org_name like concat('%',#{dept},'%')
SELECT t.emp_no FROM safety.safety_car_rule_white t where t.status = 0
